name: Doctor Moire Dizzywink
description: Black and white shapes that refuse to hold still. Not recommended for the seasick.

designs.title: Striped Sphere
designs.description: A globe made only of curved bands that bulge towards you. Sits best on a round shoulder.

designs.title: Checker Bulge
designs.description: A checkerboard swelling out of its square frame. Works on a kneecap for obvious reasons.

designs.title: Hypnotic Spiral
designs.description: Two black arms winding into a point. Look at it for a while. You are getting sleepy.

designs.title: Ripple Rings
designs.description: Concentric rings that wobble as if something was dropped into them from far above.

designs.title: Nested Tunnel
designs.description: Black and white squares twisting down a tunnel with no floor. A good one for the palm.
